versions.title: Living streets, two frames
versions.description: Light Gamified default with a separate collapsed style panel, city-specific lettering and films, crowd-responsive frame rates, stacked camera/print wheels, grouped Chronicle events and a larger recovery gallery; varied blocks, colored motorcycles, mini-roundabouts and fair traffic.

versions.title: Nineteen cities, a hundred landmarks
versions.description: 19 destinations with 102 seeded architectural motifs, including Antalya's Yivli Minare and Saat Kulesi. Modern Istanbul clock numerals; 176 px dial with stacked speed controls; colorful wheel strokes. New vehicles keep moving while searching for a home, while yielding to real obstacles. Researched approximate Polaroid borders, 440 px control pane, mixed car/motorcycle spawns and animated rescue Junkyard. Original defaults to 600 px Polaroid / Close up / Auto 30 FPS. v14 preserves the prior layout.
